title: 第007章 他是替继妹出头
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

舒楹体感不是很舒服。

不知道是不是她的错觉，现在这个样子的许栀意让她有了小时候被抢礼物的感觉。

她把手机拿回来，向程昱道谢。

sy：【谢谢你，我会联系王女士的】

sy：【刚刚是我妹妹开玩笑，你别放在心上】

程昱回得很快。

映画传媒-程昱：【你跟许栀意居然是姐妹？】

映画传媒-程昱：【那我以后岂不是不能跟你吐槽她跟阿渝了？】（已撤回）

后面这条他撤回得很快，但舒楹看得很清楚。

她没懂这里面的意思，打了个问号丢过去。

“姐，你生气了吗？”许栀意凑到舒楹身旁的沙发上，小心翼翼地端详着她。

“没生气。”舒楹从小就习惯了不和许栀意计较，怪的是她们每次化干戈为玉帛，接下来都会有更大的战争在等着她们。

“反正程二肯定对你有点小心思。”许栀意依然坚持她的想法。

她细细看着舒楹的脸，冷不丁问道：“对了，上次我不是说要找你拍婚纱照吗？我最近在研究去哪里拍呢，姐你去过那么多国家，帮我出出主意呗。”

这么快就把拍婚纱照提上日程了吗？

舒楹没说她出国拍的纪录片都是人文题材，给不了太好的建议。

“谢亭渝的团队应该比我要了解。”她说。

“其实是我想有点参与感。”许栀意不好意思地笑笑，“他怕我辛苦，不让我策划这些的。”

舒楹被强硬塞了口狗粮，没等她给出回应，又有新的粮食追着她跑，“姐，我看程二帮了你挺多的。你要是怕尴尬的话，看看哪天有空，我跟阿渝陪你一起请他吃顿饭。”

舒楹不确定是不是她多想了，许栀意好像在很积极地打入谢亭渝的社交圈。

但他们的关系是摆在明面上的，许栀意的性格喜欢主动表现也很正常。

重点是……谢亭渝真的很在意她。

她在心里吁了口气，赶走杂七杂八的想法，故作轻松道：“可以啊。”

“那就这么说定啦，我一会就跟阿渝说。”许栀意得到她的答复，心满意足地走了。

Page (1/3)

Shu Ying felt uncomfortable.

I don't know if it was her imagination, but the way Xu Zhiyi looked now made her feel like she was robbed of gifts when she was a child.

She took her phone back and thanked Cheng Yu.

sy: [Thank you, I will contact Ms. Wang]

sy: [My sister was just joking, don’t take it to heart]

Cheng Yu returned quickly.

Filming Media-Cheng Yu: [You and Xu Zhiyi are actually sisters?】

Movie Media-Cheng Yu: [Then I won’t be able to complain about her and Ayu to you in the future?】(Withdrawn)

He withdrew the latter part very quickly, but Shu Ying saw it clearly.

She didn't understand the meaning, so she put a question mark and threw it over.

"Sister, are you angry?" Xu Zhiyi leaned on the sofa next to Shu Ying and looked at her carefully.

"Not angry." Shu Ying has been accustomed to not arguing with Xu Zhi since she was a child. The strange thing is that every time they turn their hostility into friendship, there will be a bigger war waiting for them next.

"Anyway, Cheng Er must be a little jealous of you." Xu Zhiyi still insisted on her idea.

She looked at Shu Ying's face carefully and asked abruptly: "By the way, didn't I say I wanted you to take wedding photos last time? I've been researching where to take photos recently. Sister, you have been to so many countries, please give me some advice."

Are you planning to take wedding photos so soon?

Shu Ying didn't say that the documentaries she shot abroad were all about humanities, so she couldn't give good advice.

"Xie Tingyu's team should know better than me," she said.

"Actually, I want to have a sense of participation." Xu Zhi smiled sheepishly, "He was afraid of my hard work and wouldn't let me plan this."

Shu Ying was forcefully stuffed with dog food. Before she could respond, new food came chasing her, "Sister, I think Cheng Er has helped you a lot. If you are afraid of embarrassment, see if you are free one day, Ayu and I will accompany you to treat him to a meal."

Shu Ying wasn't sure if she was overthinking it. Xu Zhiyi seemed to be actively trying to get into Xie Tingyu's social circle.

But their relationship is on the surface, and it's normal for Xu Zhiyi's character to like to take the initiative.

The point is...Xie Tingyu really cares about her.

She breathed a sigh of relief in her heart, got rid of all the miscellaneous thoughts, and pretended to be relaxed: "Okay."

"Then it's settled, I'll tell Ayu soon." Xu Zhiyi got her answer and left with satisfaction.
